newsitem.title: CANADA: Alcan reroll sheet plant evacuated for fire.
newsitem.headline: Alcan reroll sheet plant evacuated for fire.

text.p: Alcan Aluminium Ltd said on Thursday that a continuous casting plant that makes reroll sheet at its Saguenay works in Jonquiere, Quebec was evacuated at midday because of a chimney fire.

Alcan spokesman Charles Belbin told Reuters there were no injuries in the fire and workers were evacuated from the plant as a precaution as firefighters fought the fire, which appeared to be localized in a chimney.
The plant accepts molten material from a smelter and makes reroll aluminum sheet, which is then shipped to other Alcan facilites for further processing.
